answer_1.quote: For most text generation tasks, reference-based ngram overlap methods are still the dominant means of automatic evaluation.

answer_2.quote: we show that a relatively direct application of CLIP to (image, generated caption) pairs results in surprisingly high correlation with human judgments on a suite of standard image description benchmarks
